jobs.description_text: Summary The First Electronics Corporation (FEC) is an engineering and custom cable manufacturing company based in Braintree, Massachusetts, FEC is AS9100D certified and provides custom cable design and assembly to defense and aerospace customers. Job Summary The Testing Technician is responsible for testing cable and wire products to ensure they meet all quality standards, specifications, and regulations. This includes performing electrical tests, and functional tests. This position requires the use of High Voltage, all safety guidelines, procedures, and regulations to prevent accidents and ensure a safe working environment must be followed. The Testing Technician is a respected team player that works well with diverse internal team members. As well as self-motivated, results-driven, and demonstrate problem solving skills with sound judgment as well as attention to detail while collaborating with peers, teamwork oriented, and supporting overall team success. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Conduct visual and electrical tests on cable and wire products to ensure they meet performance requirements. When required, perform functional tests on cable and wire products to ensure they operate as designed. Document the results of all tests. Create, update, compile, save and maintain documentation into internal database. Detect and report unusual or non-conforming documentation, materials, conditions, or product to Quality Manager. jobs.title: Annotateur(trice) de données (durée déterminée)
jobs.description_text: À propos de l’entreprise À Torc, nous avons toujours cru que la technologie des véhicules autonomes transformera la façon dont nous voyageons, transportons la marchandise et faisons des affaires. Leader de la conduite autonome depuis 2007, Torc a passé plus d’une décennie à commercialiser des solutions aux côtés de partenaires chevronnés. Nous faisons maintenant partie de la famille Daimler, ce qui nous permet de nous concentrer uniquement sur le développement de logiciels pour les camions automatisés. Nous transformerons la façon dont le monde transporte la marchandise. Joignez-vous à notre équipe : catapultez votre carrière au sein de l’entreprise ayant contribué à créer la technologie de conduite autonome (CA). Nous sommes la première entreprise de logiciels de CA ayant eu la vision de faire équipe directement avec un constructeur de camions. À propos du poste Nous sommes à la recherche d’annotateurs(trices) de données minutieux(ses) pour se joindre à notre équipe dans le cadre d’un poste à durée déterminée de six mois. Une prolongation ou une conversion en emploi régulier pourra être envisagée selon les besoins de l’entreprise et le rendement, mais n’est pas garantie. Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez au processus d’annotation et d’assurance qualité des données de Torc en étiquetant des informations provenant de différents capteurs, notamment des images et des données LiDAR, afin d’aider à entraîner les systèmes d’intelligence artificielle utilisés dans les camions autonome

jobs.title: Autonomous Fleet Specialist
jobs.description_text: What You’ll Do As a Freight Operations Specialist at Torc, you will have the opportunity to support the safe execution of tests in our autonomous vehicles. While riding in vehicles for testing you will be responsible for continuously monitoring external weather and traffic environments, road and infrastructure conditions, vehicle operations, safety driver operations, and software data to ensure a safe transportation experience. If you would like to make a positive impact on the development of autonomous vehicles this may be the role for you! Performs a pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspection, software deployment and offloading, and safety checks (including driver physical and mental performance) to verify tasks are completed and performs a safety brief. Check for any vehicle groundings or statuses prior to test and monitor updates during the test. Pause or stop of vehicle operations or tests at any point to reduce risks and immediately inform the operations manager. In the event of an incident, perform analyses to determine the response and execution of responsibilities for safe mitigation. Review daily logistics reports and conditions (road, traffic, weather, etc.) to understand test opportunities Share detailed analysis, concise feedback and documentation regarding test runs with engineers and managers. jobs.description_text: Meet the Team We are looking for detail-oriented Data Annotators to join our team in a six-month fixed-term role. Extension or conversion to regular employment may be considered based on business need and performance, but it isn’t guaranteed. In this role, you will help support Torc’s data annotation and quality assurance pipeline by labeling information from different sensors, including images and LiDAR, to help train AI systems used in autonomous trucks. What You’ll Do As a Data Annotator, you’ll work with both 2D images and 3D sensor data to help our AI systems recognize and understand their surroundings. Your responsibilities will include: Labeling objects using specialized tools to create: 2D bounding boxes 3D cuboids Other shape types to represent vehicles, road features, obstacles, and more Reviewing pre-labeled data to ensure it follows detailed guidelines Accepting, rejecting, or correcting annotations using our software Providing clear notes when corrections are needed Learning and mastering our internal tools over time Your work directly supports the development of safer autonomous vehicle technology by ensuring the AI models used on those vehicles are trained with high-quality, accurate data. jobs.description_text: What you will do: As the HiL Test Manager, you will lead a team of HiL test engineers responsible for the hardware-in-the-loop verification and validation (V&V) of Torc’s autonomous truck. You will own the HiL test strategy and set the technical direction for the team, ensuring that HiL test evidence supports Torc’s safety case and aligns with ISO 26262 (functional safety) and ISO 21448 (SOTIF). Lead, mentor, and grow a team of HiL test engineers, setting clear goals, priorities, and development plans. Define and own the HiL test strategy, roadmap, and technical direction in support of Torc’s autonomous truck safety case. Ensure HiL test methods, processes, and evidence align with ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 (SOTIF), including verification of safety mechanisms and fault handling, and testing of triggering conditions and performance limitations. Plan and oversee HiL test campaigns, including resourcing, scheduling, bench allocation, and delivery against program milestones. jobs.title: Senior, ML Engineer - Tracking
jobs.description_text: Meet the Team Accurate and highly available information about other actors and objects is fundamental to the safe operation of autonomous trucks. Core capabilities depend on accurate tracking estimates to ensure safe and efficient vehicle behavior. The Tracking Team develops the ML models, state estimation algorithms, and production software responsible for associating and estimating the kinematics of other actors and objects in real time. Our solutions fuse information from multiple sensors and maintain robust performance despite sensor imperfections, environmental challenges, and system degradation. As part of this team, you will develop and deploy production-ready tracking solutions and help solve the challenges of bringing autonomous vehicle technology to real-world commercial applications. What You'll Do Design, develop, and deploy production ML models for multi-object tracking, including association, learned pose and kinematic estimation, and sensor fusion using camera, LiDAR, radar, and other vehicle sensors. Develop scalable training and evaluation workflows using PyTorch, distributed training infrastructure, and large-scale real-world datasets. Design and improve tracking and sensor fusion algorithms for robust vehicle pose and kinematics Analyze large-scale vehicle data to characterize performance, identify failure modes, and drive model and system improvements. Develop robust, efficient production software in modern C++ and Python across the full development lifecy

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description_text: This is a hybrid position, currently requiring a minimum of two days per week onsite at our office located at 2 Queen St. E in Toronto, ON. The Role We're looking for an experienced developer to join TripArc as a Senior Software Developer. You'll work on a mature travel platform that thousands of travel professionals rely on every day, and you'll help us modernize it: moving legacy .NET systems onto Azure-hosted microservices while the business keeps running. You'll own problems end to end. Some days that means untangling a decade-old stored procedure to find out what the business rule actually is. Other days it means designing a new service, or fixing something in production. If that variety sounds energizing, you'll fit in. We expect our seniors to write excellent code themselves. Our developers use AI tools such as GitHub Copilot where they help, but you are accountable for every line you ship, and that only works if you could have written it yourself. AI is good at plausible code and weak at the undocumented rules buried in legacy systems. The people who catch its mistakes are the people who know the code. You'll work in two-week sprints with QA, Product, and stakeholders. We expect you to drive your own work: clarify requirements, push back when a timeline doesn't make sense, and help teammates who are stuck. jobs.title: Account Executive, Product Sales - Open Issuance
jobs.description_text: Who we are About Stripe Stripe builds financial infrastructure for businesses—from ambitious startups to global enterprises. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we’re building the tools that help businesses participate in and grow the global economy. About the team Stripe’s Crypto team is building financial infrastructure for a world where money moves as easily as information. Across Stripe, Bridge, and Privy, we help businesses build products powered by stablecoins, wallets, and programmable money movement. Open Issuance is central to that opportunity. Built by Bridge, a Stripe company, it enables businesses to launch and manage their own stablecoins. Alongside it, Open Standard—the independent organization behind Open USD (OUSD)—is building a shared stablecoin network with broad distribution and economics designed to benefit the businesses driving adoption. We’re hiring one of the founding sellers of our Open Issuance go-to-market team. You’ll partner closely with Open Standard and teams across Stripe, Bridge, and Privy on a major strategic bet: challenging the stablecoin duopoly and giving businesses more choice, control, and participation in the economics of digital dollars. This is an opportunity to help build a market—not simply sell into an established one. What you'll do As a Solutions Engineer on the AI Build team, you’ll work directly with frontier AI companies on the payments, billing, and monetization infrastructure underlying their core businesses. You’ll own complex proof-of-concept engagements on Stripe’s frontier products, from initial scoping through activation and handoff, combining customer discovery, solution design, rapid prototyping, and cross-functional leadership. You won’t simply implement a finished product: you’ll build with customers, identify where Stripe’s products or integrations need to evolve, and help customers feel as though they are inside our product roadmap. You will report to and work closely with the Head of SOX Compliance. jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Supportability Decisions
jobs.description_text: About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. About the team Supportability sits at the vital intersection of platform safety, regulatory trust and merchant growth. Our mission is to ensure legitimate businesses can seamlessly onboard and thrive on Stripe, while proactively safeguarding the financial ecosystem from bad actors and high-risk activity. The Supportability Decisions team is a newly forming pillar anchored in our Dublin office. In this role, you will be the foundational technical lead establishing this capability in Dublin. Our mission is to accelerate Stripe’s global expansion by building the canonical Supportability Decision Layer; a stateful distributed platform that provides unified, real-time, and explainable risk determinations to unlock fast, compliant merchant onboarding and payment method expansion worldwide. Doing this at scale requires solving high-stakes risk challenges with precision. Deceptive merchant activity, such as transaction laundering, introduces significant threats as bad actors actively adapt to mask illicit and unsupported activities behind legitimate storefronts. Rather than relying on rigid, fragmented controls that create unnecessary friction for good users, our team builds the intelligent decision systems that systematically separate legitimate businesses from adversarial behavior, enabling Stripe to grow safely and aggressively. jobs.description_text: About the team The Compute Foundation group builds and operates the core systems that enable every Stripe engineer to ship code, configuration, and infrastructure changes safely and at high velocity. Embedded on the Imaging team, you will design, build, and distribute Linux machine images; manage host bootstrapping and OS-configuration systems; oversee OS packages and security-patching infrastructure; and provide platforms that empower service teams to safely run workloads across cloud providers and regions. What you’ll do Own the foundation of Stripe’s compute fleet: Stripe’s services rely on host infrastructure that boots reliably, receives accurate configurations, and operates safely. Your decisions will directly shape the base operating system, package ecosystems, security posture, and bootstrap behavior of Stripe’s fleet. Lead active architectural transformations: The team is driving key platform evolutions, including modernizing the OS configuration layer, containerizing workloads, scaling machine image distribution across multi-cloud regions, and streamlining OS upgrades and critical security patching. We are building the infrastructure for a world where AI agents transact on your behalf, stablecoins go mainstream, and identity dictates how money moves. The Consumer Preference team is building the Link experience across the web app and agents — building the wallet product consumers need to feel confident, excited, and inspired by the new ways payments and identity are changing online. As a senior member of the team, you will create new experiences such as financial insights powered by purchase history, rewards cards backed by a stablecoin balance, safe agentic purchase UX, automatic purchase protections, and subscription management. The ideal candidate will combine technical depth across the stack with a strong product sense. In this role, you will take ambiguous product opportunities, create ways to validate them early, and ultimately ship complete products.
